nodes.description: Nested mapping (address => address => uint256) tracking per-user per-token deposit balances.
Sentinel address(0x0) representing native ETH in adminWithdrawTokens.
Contract owner address, set to msg.sender in constructor and used by onlyOwner and selfdestruct.
Fixed array of six stakable ERC20 token addresses populated in populateData.
Fixed array of six human-readable stakable token names populated in populateData.
Payable constructor; assigns owner = msg.sender and calls populateData.
Public function writing dummy token address and name arrays; callable by anyone.
Public deposit; pulls tokens via transferFrom and increments depositBalances with unchecked addition.
Public withdraw; decrements depositBalances with unchecked subtraction then transfers tokens out.
View getter returning the stakable token address and name arrays.
View function that writes to uninitialized memory arrays and returns them.
View function returning pseudo-random APY derived from token address.
View function returning a hard-coded aggregated TVL.
View function returning hard-coded value plus random(3).
View function returning a hard-coded internal TVL.
View function that calls random(2) and returns no value explicitly.
View getter returning depositBalances[user][token].
View function returning random(1) as a mock token price.
View function returning pseudo-random reward for a user address.
View function returning pseudo-random potential reward via random(7).
Internal view pseudo-random generator using now, msg.sender and a nonce (weak randomness / timestamp dependency).
Function querying an arbitrary ERC20 balanceOf for a user address.
onlyOwner function transferring native ETH or ERC20 tokens to an arbitrary destination.
onlyOwner virtual function performing selfdestruct(owner).
Modifier restricting execution to msg.sender == owner; silently continues otherwise.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, deposits, withdrawals, randomness and access checks.
now, used as a randomness input inside random (block timestamp dependency).
selfdestruct(owner) destroying the contract and forwarding funds to owner.
destination.transfer(amount) forwarding native currency to an arbitrary payable address.
Unchecked addition depositBalances[msg.sender][tokenAddress] + amount in deposit (overflow risk).
Unchecked subtraction depositBalances[msg.sender][tokenAddress] - amount in withdraw (underflow risk).
External call thisToken.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount) in deposit.
External call thisToken.transfer(msg.sender, amount) in withdraw.

ERC20 instance created from tokenAddress in deposit.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner in the constructor, establishing privileged control.
msg.sender is used as the token source and balance key in deposit.
msg.sender determines the depositor balance decremented in withdraw.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner to gate execution.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random number, making randomness caller-influenced.
block.timestamp (now) is used as a randomness input, creating timestamp dependency.
getAPY invokes random using the token address as nonce.
getTotalValueLockedInternalByToken invokes random(3).
timeLeftInEpoch invokes random(2).
getThisTokenPrice invokes random(1).
getUserCurrentReward invokes random with the user address.
getUserPotentialReward invokes random(7).
constructor calls populateData to seed dummy token data.
adminWithdrawTokens is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
kill is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier, restricting selfdestruct to owner.
kill executes selfdestruct(owner).
adminWithdrawTokens performs destination.transfer(amount) for the native ETH branch.
deposit performs an external ERC20 transferFrom call which could reenter the contract.
withdraw performs an external ERC20 transfer call which could reenter the contract.
tokenAddress parameter flows into deposit.
amount parameter flows into deposit.
tokenAddress parameter flows into withdraw.
amount parameter flows into withdraw.
tokenAddress parameter flows into getAPY.
tokenAddress parameter flows into getTotalValueLockedInternalByToken.
tokenAddress parameter flows into getAmountStakedByUser.
userAddress parameter flows into getAmountStakedByUser.
userAddress parameter flows into getUserCurrentReward.
userAddress parameter flows into getUserPotentialReward.
userAddress parameter flows into getUserWalletBalance.
tokenAddress parameter flows into getUserWalletBalance.
nonce parameter flows into random.
token parameter flows into adminWithdrawTokens.
amount parameter flows into adminWithdrawTokens.
destination parameter flows into adminWithdrawTokens.
deposit tokenAddress selects the ERC20 contract used for transferFrom.
deposit amount is added to the stored balance with unchecked arithmetic.
withdraw amount is subtracted from the stored balance with unchecked arithmetic.
adminWithdrawTokens amount is forwarded to destination.transfer.
adminWithdrawTokens destination receives the native transfer.
thisToken local variable is declared inside deposit.
thisToken instance is used to issue the external transferFrom call.
thisToken local variable is declared inside withdraw.
thisToken instance is used to issue the external transfer call.
randomnumber local is computed inside random.
token local ERC20 instance is declared inside getUserWalletBalance.
tokenToken local ERC20 instance is declared inside adminWithdrawTokens.
Unchecked addition result is written back to depositBalances (overflow risk).
Unchecked subtraction result is written back to depositBalances (underflow risk).
depositBalances user key is derived from msg.sender.
withdraw tokenAddress selects the ERC20 contract used for transfer.
ERC20 instance token is constructed from the tokenAddress parameter.
ERC20 instance tokenToken is constructed from the token parameter.
